$comment: Prompt templates for the offline Gemini asset build. GeminiAssetBuilder expands these against the game data (lakes, species, lures) into concrete asset jobs. IDs must match src/game/assets.ts.
style: Stylized modern illustration for a premium mobile sports game. Clean confident shapes, soft painterly shading, natural but vibrant palette, crisp readable silhouettes. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, UI elements, or human faces.

plates.template: First-person view from the casting deck of a bass boat looking out across {lake}, toward {cover}. {weather} Wide landscape composition: horizon in the upper third, open water filling the lower two thirds, nothing in the immediate foreground (the game draws lures and the fishing line on top). No boat, no fishing rod, no people.

lakes.champlain: Lake Champlain between New York and Vermont: clear blue-green water, forested shorelines, distant Adirondack and Green Mountain ridgelines, granite outcrops

covers.open: open water and a distant tree-lined shoreline
covers.rock: a rocky point with rounded granite boulders breaking the surface near the shore
covers.grass: a shallow weedy bay with milfoil beds and lily pads near the surface
covers.dock: a small marina with weathered wooden boat docks, pilings and a few moored boats
covers.reeds: a shoreline lined with tall reeds and bulrushes
covers.timber: fallen trees and standing dead timber along a steep bank

weathers.bluebird: Bright bluebird sky, crisp high sun, calm surface with gentle ripples and sparkling highlights.
weathers.overcast: Flat grey overcast sky, soft diffuse light, muted cool colours, glassy water.
weathers.windy: Breezy day with fast scattered clouds and wind-chopped water with small whitecaps.
weathers.rain: Light steady rain under dark low clouds, rain-dimpled water surface, misty distance.

portraits.template: Catch-of-the-day hero shot: a {sizeClass} {species} leaping clear of the water, full side profile filling the frame, mouth open, gills flared, wet glistening scales and water droplets, splash below, softly blurred lake background. {features}

species.largemouth: largemouth bass: olive-green back, dark broken lateral stripe, jaw extending past the eye
species.smallmouth: smallmouth bass: bronze-brown body with dark vertical bars, red-orange eye
species.spotted: spotted bass: green back with rows of dark spots below the lateral line, rough tongue patch
species.pike: northern pike: long torpedo body, green with pale bean-shaped spots, duck-bill snout
species.pickerel: chain pickerel: slender body with dark chain-link pattern on golden-green sides
species.bowfin: bowfin: long dorsal fin running most of the back, olive mottled body, rounded tail with an eye spot
species.drum: freshwater drum: silvery-grey humped back, rounded tail, blunt head

icons.template: A single fishing lure, {lure}, in {color} colour ({hex}). Isolated product icon centred on a plain deep teal background ({bg}), soft studio lighting, slight three-quarter angle, sharp detail, fills about 70% of the frame.

lures.ned: a short buoyant soft-plastic stick bait on a small mushroom jighead
lures.dropShot: a slender soft-plastic finesse minnow nose-hooked on a drop-shot rig with a small cylindrical weight below
lures.tube: a hollow soft-plastic tube bait with a skirt of tentacles at the tail
lures.jerkbait: a slim hard-plastic suspending jerkbait minnow with a small diving lip and three treble hooks
lures.squarebill: a chunky hard-plastic squarebill crankbait with a square diving lip and two treble hooks
lures.walker: a cigar-shaped hard-plastic walking topwater plug with two treble hooks
lures.chatterbait: a bladed swim jig with a hexagonal metal blade at the nose, silicone skirt and a soft-plastic trailer
lures.footballJig: a tungsten football-head jig with a flowing silicone skirt, weed guard and a craw trailer

tracks.menu: Instrumental, about 2 minutes. Easygoing americana rock with warm electric guitar riffs and steady drums, confident and friendly, outdoor sports broadcast feel. Even energy throughout with no intro build and no big ending, so it can repeat smoothly.
tracks.fishing: Instrumental, about 2 minutes. Gentle acoustic guitar and soft ambient pads with light brushed percussion. Calm, steady and unobtrusive background music for a relaxed outdoor game. No intro and no ending, so it can repeat smoothly.
tracks.weighin: Instrumental, about 2 minutes. Upbeat confident country-rock with slide guitar and driving drums, tournament weigh-in stage energy. Steady groove throughout with no intro build and no ending, so it loops seamlessly.

scenes.$comment: Menu backdrops (ui_<name>). Hub hotspots are positioned against these in src/ui/screens/marina.ts, so regenerate with care.

items.marina: A small lakeside marina on Lake Champlain at golden early morning, seen from slightly above. Left third: a modest weathered tackle shop building with a covered porch, warm light in the windows. Centre: a concrete boat launch ramp sloping into calm water. Right third: a long wooden dock with a sleek modern bass boat tied alongside, its front casting deck visible. Far right background: a small open-sided pavilion. Forested shoreline and distant mountains, light mist on the water. No people, no signs, no lettering.
items.stage: An outdoor bass tournament weigh-in stage at a lakeside park at dusk. A covered stage with warm spotlights, a large digital fish scale on a stand with a plain blank display, a glass-sided aerated holding tank in front, folding chairs facing the stage, plain unmarked fabric banners, string lights, lake and treeline behind. Centre of the frame kept relatively open and dark for overlays. No people, no text, no logos.
items.shop: Interior of a well-kept small-town fishing tackle shop in warm morning light: a pegboard wall of unbranded lures in plain clear packaging, rod racks along one side, a worn wooden counter, a window looking out to the lake. Calm and uncluttered, left side darker and simpler for overlays. No people, no labels, no readable text.
items.locker: Looking down at the front casting deck of a modern bass boat on the water: grey marine carpet, an open rod locker hatch, a trolling motor at the bow, tackle trays neatly stowed, calm lake water around the hull. Even lighting, uncluttered composition with open carpet space in the middle. No people, no rods on the deck, no text.
items.trophy: A quiet lakeside lodge trophy room at evening: dark wood-panelled wall with a few mounted bass replicas and plain blank brass plaques, a framed lake chart, warm lamp light, a window with the lake at dusk. Restrained, premium, uncluttered. No people, no readable text.

rods.template: A single {desc}, shown in full lying horizontally across the frame from left to right with the reel near the left. Isolated product shot on a plain deep teal background (#0b1d26), soft studio lighting, sharp detail, unbranded.

reels.spinning: {len} {power} light graphite spinning rod with cork split-grip handle and a compact silver spinning reel hanging beneath
reels.casting: {len} {power} graphite casting rod with a split-grip handle and a low-profile baitcasting reel mounted on top

powers.XH: extra-heavy flipping rod, very thick butt section and long handle

stings.$comment: Short musical cues (sting_<name>), generated with the clip model, trimmed from the start.

hotseat.prompt: Instrumental. [0:00 - 0:03] A short triumphant sports-broadcast sting: punchy drum hit and a bright rising slide-guitar lick ending on a strong major chord, then let ring. [0:03 - 0:30] Silence.

hold.prompt: Instrumental. [0:00 - 0:03] A short tense sports-broadcast sting: low tom hits and a suspended guitar chord that stays unresolved, then fade. [0:03 - 0:30] Silence.

promote.prompt: Instrumental. [0:00 - 0:05] A short celebratory americana fanfare: full band hit, bright electric guitar and slide guitar flourish resolving on a big major chord, cymbal swell. [0:05 - 0:30] Silence.

record.prompt: Instrumental. [0:00 - 0:03] A short bright reward sting: shimmering guitar harmonics and a soft cymbal swell rising to a clean major chord. [0:03 - 0:30] Silence.

build.prompt: Instrumental. [0:00 - 0:06] A short suspense build for a weigh-in reveal: steady kick drum pulse and a rising tremolo electric guitar note getting louder, stopping abruptly. [0:06 - 0:30] Silence.

sfx.$comment: UI cues (sfx_ui_<name>). Gemini has no SFX model, so these are single musical hits from the clip model, trimmed to the first sound.

tap.prompt: Instrumental. [0:00 - 0:01] One single short muted electric guitar string pluck, dry, close and soft. [0:01 - 0:30] Silence.

back.prompt: Instrumental. [0:00 - 0:01] One single soft low plucked guitar note falling slightly in pitch, short and dry. [0:01 - 0:30] Silence.

confirm.prompt: Instrumental. [0:00 - 0:01] Two quick rising clean electric guitar notes, bright and short. [0:01 - 0:30] Silence.

buy.prompt: Instrumental. [0:00 - 0:01] A single bright clean electric guitar chord strum with a light shaker, short. [0:01 - 0:30] Silence.

open.prompt: Instrumental. [0:00 - 0:01] One quick soft upward slide on an acoustic guitar string, short. [0:01 - 0:30] Silence.

tick.prompt: Instrumental. [0:00 - 0:01] One single dry rimshot click on a snare drum, very short. [0:01 - 0:30] Silence.
